prompt.default: Use my Amber Notes note "Meal plan and groceries". On the weekend, ask me which nights we're cooking and anything to avoid, then suggest dinners and fill in the Dinners table with edit_note (read the note with read_note first). Then add what we need under "Groceries" as a checklist with append_to_note, grouped by aisle, leaving out what's under "Always in the cupboard". Keep weeknight dinners under 30 minutes. If I add something during the week, add it to the list.

asks: Plan dinners for this week. We're out on Friday, and no mushrooms.
Add oat milk and lemons to the groceries.

| Tuesday | Pasta with tomato and basil | Jonas |
